South Indian transporters threaten strike over demands

Transporters across South India are warning of a potential flash strike on July 20 if their demands are not met. The South India Motor Transport Association (SIMTA) has issued the warning, indicating widespread disruption if the issues are not resolved. The specific demands leading to this threat have not been detailed in the provided coverage.
